title: Fallen Angel in Ruins
description: A ram-horned humanoid figure with large feathered wings stands centrally amid ancient stone ruins. The character wears a long white coat over red and dark garments, with papers scattered across the broken stone floor around its feet.
prompt: A majestic ram-horned humanoid with massive white and golden feathered wings stands in the center of ancient ruined stone architecture. It has dark skin, wears an open long white coat over a red vest and dark robes, with intricate golden patterns on its legs. Scattered papers and broken stone tiles cover the ground. A glowing halo with radiating spikes floats behind its head. Dramatic sunset lighting with volumetric fog and hanging lightbulb above, cinematic fantasy style.
